name: Vorssaint
title: Vorssaint: free SoundSource alternative
hook: SoundSource charges you forty nine bucks to control the volume of every app. This app does it for free.
job: Sets the volume for each app

features.say: Set the volume for each app, and boost quiet audio past a hundred percent.
A real system monitor shows temperatures, CPU, GPU and memory.
Plus window snapping, a better app switcher, and clipboard history.

caption:
SoundSource charges $49. Vorssaint does per-app volume for free 🎚

✅ Volume mixer: set each app's volume, boost past 100%
✅ System monitor: CPU, GPU, memory and temperatures
✅ Window snapping, app switcher and clipboard history
✅ No account, no tracking, no subscription

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Apple Silicon only, macOS 14+
